outcome: Themes related to challenging oneself as a childbearing woman
Regained trust in the ability to give birth vaginally
cohort: Nine women who had a vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC) in an urban region of Sweden.
finding: The essential meaning of the VBAC experience was 'to challenge oneself as a childbearing woman', encompassing themes of seeking professional support, desiring the experience, comparing previous births, and engagement with birthing culture.
mod_finding: The experience of VBAC led to regained trust in the ability to give birth vaginally, highlighting the need for enhanced support after CS and during subsequent pregnancy.
